description: This file defines a function getSampleNotes that provides initial sample notes for a personal notes application. It imports utility functions for generating unique IDs and current timestamps, and returns a static array of sample note objects with properties like id, title, content, tags, createdAt, and updatedAt.

methods.name: getSampleNotes()
methods.description: Returns an array of sample note objects with predefined titles, contents, tags, and timestamps, intended to display when no user data is available.
